title: Intel reportedly to invest about $100M in SambaNova

sources.quote: Other investors in the oversubscribed round include existing backer Intel Corp, which currently plans to invest about $100 million, with potential commitments of up to $150 million, two of the sources said.

explain: After talks for Intel to buy SambaNova for about $1.6B stalled, Intel instead planned to put about $100M (possibly up to $150M) into SambaNova's new funding round, according to Reuters sources. Later reports put Intel's actual February investment at a smaller $35M, so the amount is uncertain.
